name: Massive
description:
Stocks, options & indices market data via Massive.com financial data API. Access real-time and historical prices, quotes, trades, and aggregates for equities, options contracts, ETFs, FX, crypto, futures, and more. Massive brings institutional-grade market data directly into Claude. 

Stocks & equities: Real-time stock prices, historical stock data, tick-level trades and quotes, OHLC aggregates and candlestick bars, market snapshots, and stock ticker reference data for all US equities and ETFs, sourced from all US exchanges.

Options: Options contracts data including options chains, options prices, quotes, trades, open interest, and historical options data across the full US listed options market.

Futures: Futures market data including futures contracts, futures prices, trades, quotes, and historical futures data across major products.

Indices: Real-time and historical index data including index values and aggregates for major market indices.

Forex & crypto: Currency pairs, exchange rates, crypto prices, and historical FX and cryptocurrency market data.

Beyond prices, pull company fundamentals and financials, corporate actions like dividends and stock splits, market news, technical indicators (SMA, EMA, MACD, RSI), and market status. Ask Claude natural-language questions — "show me NVDA's opening cross" or "chart AAPL's daily bars this quarter" — and get answers backed by licensed, exchange-sourced market data.

Built for traders, quants, analysts, and developers who need accurate stock market data, equities data, and multi-asset market data inside Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Massive to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Massive to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.massive.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Massive MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Massive provides these MCP tools: call_api, query_data, search_endpoints, and workspace.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Massive?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Massive in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Massive requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Massive is developed by Massive.com, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
